answer.explanation: The visible log events in the window show no errors, timeouts, or throttling. Every invocation has a matching END and REPORT line, and durations are well below any plausible timeout (the longest is about 616 ms). Max Memory Used stays around 96-110 MB, far under the configured sizes. The Thumbnailer and Compression functions are provisioned at 1024 MB while using about 103-110 MB, which is over-provisioning rather than an anomaly. The log is truncated after roughly 4,344 further events, so this conclusion covers only the visible portion of the window.
